backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, authentication/authorization, and multiple ordered maps for encomendas, materiais, orçamentos, clientes, and related entities with ID counters and access‑controlled queries and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, descriptions, involved files, components, tests, and confidence for requirements related to PDF generation and page ordering.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files including components, hooks, pages, and UI behavior across the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point providing the root container and loading the main React TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication via Internet Identity, navigation between orders/materials/price tables, and global dialogs for backup and sync.
frontend/src/components/AcceptOrcamentoD: Dialog allowing users to accept an orçamento and create an encomenda with validation, async mutation handling, and client data loading.
frontend/src/components/AddMaterialDialo: Dialog for creating a new material with multiple supplier price entries, validation, and submission via material creation mutation.
frontend/src/components/BackupDialog.tsx: Dialog for listing, creating, restoring, and deleting backups with confirmation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ClienteManagemen: Client management dialog allowing creation, editing, deletion, and search filtering of clientes.
frontend/src/components/EditMaterialDial: Dialog for editing a material's name and managing supplier price entries with add, edit, and delete actions.
frontend/src/components/EditOrcamentoDia: Dialog for editing an existing orçamento, including client selection, items, pricing, notes, and optional image upload.
frontend/src/components/EditOrcamentoVie: Standalone view for editing an orçamento with client filtering, item management, pricing fields, and image upload.
Dialog for editing an order, handling form state, validation, status changes, and submitting updates through order-related mutations.
frontend/src/components/EmpresaSettingsD: Dialog for viewing and updating company information and footer text using empresa and rodape queries and mutations.
frontend/src/components/GestorManagement: Management dialog that lists existing gestores, allows adding new ones with validation, and displays system readiness alerts.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/MaterialPricesMa: Interface for managing materials, including listing, searching, filtering, sorting, adding, editing, and deleting materials with price data.
frontend/src/components/NewOrcamentoDial: Dialog to create new budgets, handling clients, gestores, items, discounts, uploads, and submitting the assembled orcamento data.
frontend/src/components/NewOrcamentoView: UI for creating a new orçamento with client selection, item management, validations, image upload, and submission via queries.
frontend/src/components/NewOrderDialog.t: Dialog for creating a new order with form validation, gestor checks, and backend submission.
frontend/src/components/OrcamentoPDFDial: Loads orçamento data and generates a printable PDF preview using a new window and formatted HTML.
frontend/src/components/OrcamentosManage: Management view for listing, filtering, creating, editing, deleting, accepting, and exporting orçamentos.
Full order management interface with status tabs, filtering, dialogs for new/edit orders, gestor management, and reports.
Dialog to select status and gestor, fetch report data, generate grouped HTML content, and trigger PDF-like file download.
frontend/src/components/PriceTablesManag: UI to select price table categories and edit table rows and column titles with autosave and row management.
frontend/src/components/SyncDialog.tsx: Dialog for exporting and importing full app data via JSON files, handling download, upload, and BigInt serialization.
frontend/src/constants/orcamentoGeneralT: Exports a long Portuguese string containing general sales and warranty terms for quotes and orders.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping actor API calls for orders, gestores, and related mutations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom CSS variables, dark mode tokens, scrollbar tweaks, and compact card layout rules.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions including Tailwind class merging (cn) and a generic debounce helper.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point configuring React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radius, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata capturing project state, features, and pending requests related to adding a mandatory terms page to orçamento PDFs.
